portrait.prompt: {{common}} A strikingly handsome, polished fictional Korean man aged thirty-seven who has lived in Florence for over ten years: a clean-shaven, sharply defined face with refined features and clear healthy skin, dark hair neatly styled and swept back with a slight natural wave, confident dark eyes and a mischievous half-smile with one corner of his mouth raised, as if he has just teased you and is waiting for a comeback. He wears a crisp, well-fitted light-blue shirt with the top button open under a tailored navy linen jacket, a slim leather watch. Background: a softly blurred Florence rooftop terrace at golden hour, terracotta roofs and the warm glow of an old stone dome in the distance, no readable signs. Soft flattering golden light with a gentle rim light on the hair. Elegant men's-magazine portrait quality, clean and sophisticated, tasteful and not provocative.

full.prompt: {{common}} He wears the same crisp light-blue shirt and tailored navy linen jacket as in the portrait with slim beige trousers and polished brown leather shoes, and stands confidently on an old stone bridge over a river in Florence at golden hour, terracotta buildings and warm light behind him, one hand in his pocket, turned slightly toward the camera with a teasing half-smile. Clean and well groomed. No readable signs.

portrait.prompt: {{common}} A fictional Korean man aged thirty-one with a gentle, clean-cut, almost innocent face and sharp narrow eyes that look as if they have just seen straight through you: smooth healthy skin, neat dark hair with a soft natural fringe, thin silver-rimmed round glasses, one eyebrow slightly raised and the corner of his mouth lifted in a dry, teasing half-smile, as if he is about to click his tongue and give you a blunt verdict. He wears the clothes of a young Korean shaman, not a business suit or an office shirt: a deep indigo-blue (jjokbit) traditional hanbok jacket with a softly crossed collar and a clean white inner collar, a fine red silk thread knotted once at the collar and a bracelet of thin red thread on his wrist. No suit, no tie, no blazer, no Western shirt. Background: a softly blurred modern shrine room on the top floor of a luxury apartment tower in Seoul, warm candlelight, a low dark wooden altar table, paper lanterns, many thin red threads hanging like curtains catching the light, a pale hanbok fabric folded in the corner, no readable signs or characters anywhere. Soft flattering warm candle light with a gentle rim light on the hair. Elegant magazine-portrait quality, calm and slightly mysterious, never frightening or horror-like, tasteful and not provocative.

full.prompt: {{common}} He wears the same crisp white shirt as in the portrait with slim dark charcoal trousers and clean black leather shoes, thin silver-rimmed round glasses, and a bracelet of thin red thread wound several times around his left wrist. He stands relaxed and a little arrogant in a modern shrine room on the top floor of a Seoul apartment tower at night, a low dark wooden altar table with candles and a small brass bell beside him, many thin red threads hanging from the ceiling like curtains, floor-to-ceiling windows behind him with the blurred glittering lights of the Cheongdam district, one hand slightly lifted as if about to point at someone and scold them, his head turned toward the camera with a dry half-smile. Clean and well groomed. No readable signs or characters.

work.prompt: {{common}} He is at work as a young Korean shaman (a male fortune-teller who reads love fates), wearing a deep indigo-blue traditional hanbok jacket and trousers with a wide sash worn only for rituals, thin silver-rimmed round glasses and a bracelet of thin red thread on his wrist.
